job_title: AI Solution Architect - Agentic AI & Foundation Models (f/m/x)
job_summary: The role involves designing, co-creating, and implementing enterprise-scale agentic AI systems, translating business requirements into AI solution architectures, and integratingvarious technologies into reliable end-to-end solutions.
job_role: The candidate will be responsible for architecting and delivering AI solutions, guiding implementation teams, and improving enterprise AI platforms.
responsibilities: Design and implement enterprise-scale agentic AI systems
Translate business requirements into AI solution architectures
Leverage modern agentic AI frameworks and orchestration technologies
Combine LLMs, reasoning models, and enterprise applications into solutions
Build production-ready AI applications using modern software engineering principles
Integrate enterprise systems and databases into AI workflows
Define architecture standards and reusable design patterns for AI solutions

requirements.name: University degree in Computer Science or related field
requirements.source_text: University degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or a comparable technical field, ideally with a master’s degree or PhD.

requirements.name: 5+ years of software engineering experience
requirements.source_text: 5+ years of software engineering experience, including experience in AI development and proven hands-on expertise in designing and building enterprise AI and agentic AI solutions.

requirements.name: Strong consulting and stakeholder-management skills
requirements.source_text: Strong consulting and stakeholder-management skills, enabling you to align business units, use case teams and platform teams and drive AI initiatives from idea to enterprise-scale adoption.

requirements.name: Very good hands-on software engineering skills including Python
requirements.source_text: Very good hands-on software engineering skills, including Python, software architecture, clean code and automated testing.

requirements.name: Mastery of agentic AI frameworks
requirements.source_text: You master agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen or OpenAI Agents SDK, including MCP and tool calling.

requirements.name: Strong expertise in LLM engineering
requirements.source_text: Strong expertise in LLM engineering, including RAG, context engineering, multi-agent orchestration and evaluation as well as enterprise AI solution design.

requirements.name: Experience in building production-grade cloud solutions
requirements.source_text: Experience in building production-grade cloud solutions using AWS or Azure, CI/CD and MLOps.

requirements.name: Fluent English
requirements.source_text: strong problem-solving skills and fluent English.
